releases.name: v0.2.0 — always-on session briefing
releases.body:
Every session now hears about the channel, not just sessions that already have a peer.

- A lone session gets a compact declaration nudge (name, role, goal, summary), so it is addressable when another session appears.
- The full coordination briefing takes over as soon as a peer or an active lease exists.
- `announce: false` remains the only way to remove the briefing.

Also seeded `.opencode/wiki/` with the runtime, install, and communication-wall notes.
